title: The current is split against an independently declared frame

statements.text: The current is resolved against a separately declared timelike frame $n^\mu$ as $J^\mu = \rho_t (n^\mu + v^\mu)$, with a frame drift $v^\mu$ orthogonal to the frame. Keeping the frame and the transported current distinct removes a projector degeneracy of the 2022 formulation.

sources.quote: This removes the projector degeneracy produced when one vector is used both to define the temporal frame and to carry the projected motion.
separate the invariant density carried by that current from the density and drift measured by a declared timelike frame.
